mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, code, source_id, source_code, source_type, delivery_qty, warehouse_id, warehouse_name
mapper.select: SELECT pt.id, ptd.sku_id, ptd.sku_no, SUM(ptd.delivery_qty) AS deliveryQty FROM packing_task_detail ptd LEFT JOIN packing_task pt ON pt.id = ptd.main_id AND pt.is_deleted=FALSE WHERE ptd.is_deleted=FALSE AND ptd.main_id = #{mainId} GROUP BY pt.id, ptd.sku_id, ptd.sku_no

SELECT wc.id, wc.box_no, concat(wcs.box_length, wcs.size_unit,'*', wcs.box_width, wcs.size_unit,'*', wcs.box_height,wcs.size_unit) AS boxSize, wcs.package_weight, wc.weight_unit, wc.weighting_status, wc.packing_status, wc.packing_user_name, wcs.measure_source, wc.error_msg, wcs.box_length as length, wcs.box_width as width, wcs.box_height as height, (select string_agg(wcd.sku_no|| '*' || wcd.pack_qty, ';') from wms_carton_detail wcd where wcd.is_deleted = false and wcd.main_id = wc.id) as sku FROM wms_carton wc INNER JOIN wms_carton_spec wcs ON wcs.id = wc.spec_id AND wcs.is_deleted = FALSE JOIN wms_carton_detail wcd ON wcd.main_id = wc.id and wcd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE wc.is_deleted = FALSE AND wcd.pack_qty > 0
AND wc.packing_task_id IN
#{id}
ORDER BY wc.box_no
